text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English,
zh: 大家好，欢迎收听《Real Easy English》，
zh_hant: 大家好，歡迎收聽《Real Easy English》，

text: the podcast where we have real conversations in easy English
zh: 在这个播客里，我们用简单的英语进行真实的对话，
zh_hant: 在這個播客裡，我們用簡單的英語進行真實的對話，

text: to help you learn.
I'm Neil.
And I'm Georgie.
You can now watch this podcast and find a worksheet
zh: 你现在可以观看这期播客，并在我们的网站
zh_hant: 你現在可以觀看這期播客，並在我們的網站

text: to help you learn on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: bbclearningenglish.com 上找到帮助学习的练习题。
zh_hant: bbclearningenglish.com 上找到幫助學習的練習題。

text: So, Georgie, how are you?
I'm very tired, actually.
I've had a lot of social plans lately.
zh: 我最近有很多社交活动。
zh_hant: 我最近有很多社交活動。

text: How about you?
Yeah.
I'm fine.
Social plans.
That's interesting, because we're talking about friends today.
zh: 这很有意思，因为我们今天正是要聊聊朋友。
zh_hant: 這很有意思，因為我們今天正是要聊聊朋友。

text: Yes, we're talking about socialising ,
which means spending time with people for fun.
zh: 也就是为了开心而和别人一起相处。
zh_hant: 也就是為了開心而和別人一起相處。

text: So, Neil, do you like spending time with friends?
zh: 那尼尔，你喜欢和朋友一起相处吗？
zh_hant: 那尼爾，你喜歡和朋友一起相處嗎？

text: Yeah, I love spending time with my friends.
zh: 是的，我很喜欢和朋友们在一起。
zh_hant: 是的，我很喜歡和朋友們在一起。

text: If I don't see my friends very often,
I feel a bit sad and lonely.
zh: 我会觉得有点难过和孤单。
zh_hant: 我會覺得有點難過和孤單。

text: So yeah, I really like seeing my friends,
zh: 所以是的，我真的很喜欢见朋友，
zh_hant: 所以是的，我真的很喜歡見朋友，

text: but I don't get to see them very often
zh: 但我不常有机会见他们，
zh_hant: 但我不常有機會見他們，

text: because,
you know, we're grown ups and we have responsibilities.
zh: 你知道的，我们都是成年人了，有各自的责任。
zh_hant: 你知道的，我們都是成年人了，有各自的責任。

text: You have kids, you have lots of things going on.
I also like spending time with my friends.
zh: 我也喜欢和朋友们在一起。
zh_hant: 我也喜歡和朋友們在一起。

text: I have lots of friends.
As I said, I've had a lot of social plans lately.
zh: 就像我说的，我最近社交活动特别多。
zh_hant: 就像我說的，我最近社交活動特別多。

text: Pretty much every day I've been socialising .
Wow, so you like socialising ,
but do you like things like parties
zh: 不过你喜欢像派对这样的场合，
zh_hant: 不過你喜歡像派對這樣的場合，

text: or do you prefer smaller social events?
zh: 还是更喜欢小型的社交聚会？
zh_hant: 還是更喜歡小型的社交聚會？

text: I do really like big parties,
zh: 我确实很喜欢大型派对，
zh_hant: 我確實很喜歡大型派對，

text: because I like meeting new people.
zh: 因为我喜欢认识新朋友。
zh_hant: 因為我喜歡認識新朋友。

text: I like dancing as well.
So, at big parties, usually there's some music.
zh: 所以在大型派对上，通常会有音乐。
zh_hant: 所以在大型派對上，通常會有音樂。

text: But I do have a shy
side of my personality,
so usually a smaller event is better for me,
zh: 所以通常小一点的聚会更适合我，
zh_hant: 所以通常小一點的聚會更適合我，

text: so I can have kind of deeper conversations
zh: 这样我可以和更少的人
zh_hant: 這樣我可以和更少的人

text: with fewer people.
How about you?
Yeah.
I don't really like,
that situation where you're at a party and don't know lots of people.
zh: 那种在派对上不认识很多人的情况。
zh_hant: 那種在派對上不認識很多人的情況。

text: So a small group of people
that I mainly know,
and there's one or two people who I don't know so well, that's fine.
zh: 里面有一两个不太熟的人，那也没关系。
zh_hant: 裡面有一兩個不太熟的人，那也沒關係。

text: But a bigger group with lots of people I don't know,
zh: 但如果是一大群我大多不认识的人，
zh_hant: 但如果是一大群我大多不認識的人，

text: I really don't like that.
And why is that?
Is that because you don't like small talk ?
zh: 是因为你不喜欢闲聊吗？
zh_hant: 是因為你不喜歡閒聊嗎？

text: Yeah.
I don't really like small talk .
It feels a bit empty.
Small talk is conversations about things
that aren't important like the weather,
zh: 不重要的事情，比如天气，
zh_hant: 不重要的事情，比如天氣，

text: usually with people that you don't know very well.
zh: 通常是和你不太熟的人聊。
zh_hant: 通常是和你不太熟的人聊。

text: Yeah.
And you don't like that?
No. I find it awkward .
zh: 不喜欢。我觉得那很尴尬。
zh_hant: 不喜歡。我覺得那很尷尬。

text: I think it depends.
I think if you find a topic
quite quickly
that you have in common,
that avoids embarrassment.
But it's when you you meet someone new,
zh: 但问题是当你认识一个新朋友时，
zh_hant: 但問題是當你認識一個新朋友時，

text: you don't know them very well, obviously,
zh: 显然你还不太了解他们，
zh_hant: 顯然你還不太瞭解他們，

text: because they're new and you don't know what they like
zh: 因为他们是新认识的，你不知道他们喜欢什么、
zh_hant: 因為他們是新認識的，你不知道他們喜歡什麼、

text: or don't like or what they think is rude or not rude.
zh: 不喜欢什么，或者他们觉得什么是无礼的、什么不是。
zh_hant: 不喜歡什麼，或者他們覺得什麼是無禮的、什麼不是。

text: But if you can figure that out quite quickly,
zh: 但如果你能很快弄清楚这些，
zh_hant: 但如果你能很快弄清楚這些，

text: it's, yeah, it's usually OK.
Do you usually feel quite embarrassed then?
zh: 那你通常会觉得很尴尬吗？
zh_hant: 那你通常會覺得很尷尬嗎？

text: Sometimes, like you said,
it depends if you find something
that you have in common and you can talk about that.
zh: 共同点，然后聊那个话题。
zh_hant: 共同點，然後聊那個話題。

text: But sometimes you don't find something in common ,
zh: 但有时候你找不到共同点，
zh_hant: 但有時候你找不到共同點，

text: and then it's really I don't know, embarrassing, I suppose.
zh: 那时候就真的，我也不知道，挺尴尬的吧。
zh_hant: 那時候就真的，我也不知道，挺尷尬的吧。

text: I feel strange
just thinking about it.
zh: 光是想到这个就觉得别扭。
zh_hant: 光是想到這個就覺得彆扭。

text: I get
more energy from spending time alone
zh: 独自一人、放松、不用和任何人说话时，
zh_hant: 獨自一人、放鬆、不用和任何人說話時，

text: and relaxing and not talking to anyone.
I often get
what I call social burnout,
which means you just get exhausted from spending too much time with others.
zh: 意思是和别人相处太久会让你筋疲力尽。
zh_hant: 意思是和別人相處太久會讓你筋疲力盡。

text: How about you?
Well, yeah.
Spending time alone is also important,
and I like to do that, but not so much.
zh: 我也喜欢这样，但不算太多。
zh_hant: 我也喜歡這樣，但不算太多。

text: Not as much as maybe spending time with people.
zh: 没有和朋友相处的时间那么多。
zh_hant: 沒有和朋友相處的時間那麼多。

text: Because, like I said before,
if I'm alone for too long,
I get a bit lonely and feel a bit,
zh: 我会觉得有点孤单，感觉，
zh_hant: 我會覺得有點孤單，感覺，

text: I don't know, just lacking energy.
zh: 我也说不清，就是缺乏精力。
zh_hant: 我也說不清，就是缺乏精力。

text: We had small talk ,
zh: 我们学到了“闲聊”这个词，
zh_hant: 我們學到了“閒聊”這個詞，

text: which is
conversation
about things which aren't important,
such as the weather or the traffic.
We use small talk a lot in the UK.
We heard some adjectives to describe how you might feel
zh: 我们还听到了一些形容词，用来描述遇到新朋友时
zh_hant: 我們還聽到了一些形容詞，用來描述遇到新朋友時

text: about meeting new people.
So we had embarrassed ,
which means feeling ashamed or shy.
zh: 意思是感到害羞或不好意思。
zh_hant: 意思是感到害羞或不好意思。

text: And we also heard awkward ,
which means feeling uncomfortable when you're meeting new people.
zh: 意思是在见新朋友时感到不自在。
zh_hant: 意思是在見新朋友時感到不自在。

text: We also heard in common ,
so if you have something in common with someone,
zh: 如果你和某人有“in common”的东西，
zh_hant: 如果你和某人有“in common”的東西，

text: it means you share the same likes, dislikes, or interests with someone.
zh: 就是说你们有相同的喜好、厌恶或兴趣。
zh_hant: 就是說你們有相同的喜好、厭惡或興趣。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这期《Real Easy English》就到这里。
zh_hant: 這期《Real Easy English》就到這裡。

text: Test what you've learned by downloading the free worksheet
on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: bbclearningenglish.com 上的免费练习题，检验一下你学到了什么吧。
zh_hant: bbclearningenglish.com 上的免費練習題，檢驗一下你學到了什麼吧。

text: Next time we'll be talking about brothers and sisters.
zh: 下次我们将聊聊兄弟姐妹的话题。
zh_hant: 下次我們將聊聊兄弟姐妹的話題。

text: See you then.
Bye.
